meta.name: weekly-digests
meta.description: Generate a serial week-by-week narrative digest of a project's full claude-mem timeline. Splits the timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs one consecutive subagent per week — each receiving the prior week's carry-forward block — to produce one chapter per ISO week of data. Use when asked for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", "serial timeline", or "narrative chapters" of a project's history.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目历史按周生成连续叙事回顾
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望把项目记录自动整理成每周连续的叙事摘要
copy.tagline_en: Turn your project timeline into a week-by-week narrative.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want automatic weekly narrative summaries of your project history.

howto.what: 它把项目的 claude-mem 时间线按 ISO 周切成若干文件，再每周依次派一个子代理写一章，并把上一周的续写摘要传给下一周，产出每周一章的连载叙事；章数等于数据覆盖的周数。
howto.when: 当你要求 “weekly digests”、“week-by-week story”、“serial timeline” 等，或要为某项目历史写逐周连载章节时触发。若要单篇长报告，原文建议改用 timeline-report。

howto.what_en: It splits a project's claude-mem timeline into per-ISO-week files and runs one sequential subagent per week, each receiving the prior week's carry-forward block, producing one narrative chapter per ISO week; the chapter count equals the weeks covered.
howto.when_en: Use when asked for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", "serial timeline", or narrative chapters of a project's history. For a single long report, the source suggests timeline-report instead.
